# Get the pose of the red cube
position, quaternion_wxyz, bbox_extent = get_object_pose("red cube")

# Open the gripper
open_gripper()

# Move to the pose of the red cube
goto_pose(position, quaternion_wxyz)

# Grasp the red cube using the sample grasp pose
position_grasp, quaternion_grasp = sample_grasp_pose("red cube")

# Move to the grasp position
goto_pose(position_grasp, quaternion_grasp)

# Close the gripper
close_gripper()

# Lift the cube
lift_position = position_grasp.copy()
lift_position[2] += 0.2
goto_pose(lift_position, quaternion_grasp)
